selection_boundary: RAM_FROZEN and STATS_DONE and aligned late flags; one choice for entire pulse
valid_rule: H_valid[r] AND V_valid[r] AND calibration/time/source valid; choose highest actual gain qualified
hardware_flag_policy: RFDC sticky flags need explicit clear/event bookkeeping and window association; not clipped-sample counters
linear_compression: no ADC saturation does not prove analog linearity; compare calibrated range overlap and reject/mark unknown common front-end compression
all_invalid: INVALID; no defaultLOW and no precision replay
buffer_full: not signal overrange; changing range does not reduce one-record bytes
aux_replacement: only externalMID source + independent calibration + pulse-boundary authorized commit; loopback forbidden
configuration_defaults: qualification disabled until threshold/gain/calibration bounds validated; no fabricated numeric gain ranking
